title: Degreewise currying map
statement: For every pair of cochain complexes K,L and a cochain complex M of sheaf modules over R, and every integer n, there exists a unique morphism from the degree-n term of homComplex K (homComplex L M) to the degree-n term of homComplex (mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)) M which satisfies the localized pure-tensor currying equation HomTensorCurryCondition; this morphism is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Obtain a forward map a and its pure-tensor equation from homTensorDegreewise_construct. Independently obtain a reverse map b from homTensorDegreewise_inverse. Apply its universal inverse identities to a and package b as IsIso a. For any other c satisfying the conjunction, the same reverse map gives c followed by b equal to the identity. Then c = c followed by (b followed by a) = (c followed by b) followed by a = a by associativity and the two identities. This proves the original unique existence of an invertible map without changing its statement.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A90; combine forward existence and uniform reverse construction, proving uniqueness by composition
